title: Q2 service-capacity and three-van ramp sensitivity
prompt:
Estimate the quarterly service-capacity effect of the approved three-van request.

Begin with the service-operations request in `Requests/`. Locate and reconcile the dispatch/KPI workpapers, callback and pricing definitions, employee roster, current fleet-utilization file, approved/conditional capital-request evidence, and recent operating-review materials. Use completed Q2 work orders from the contractor-accounting MCP as the detail authority. Calculate current completed work orders, unique technicians, callbacks, first-time-fix rate, billable hours, labor-plus-material value proxy, and per-technician productivity.

For the sensitivity, assume the three vans support three incremental technicians, each producing 90% of current average technician work orders, billable hours, and value proxy. Do not call the proxy GAAP revenue and do not change the first-time-fix rate. Report current, incremental, and pro-forma quarterly metrics.

Return only one JSON object in your final response with exactly these keys: `completed_work_orders`, `unique_technicians`, `callbacks`, `first_time_fix_rate`, `billable_hours`, `revenue_proxy`, `work_orders_per_technician`, `hours_per_technician`, `proxy_per_technician`, `incremental_work_orders`, `incremental_billable_hours`, `incremental_revenue_proxy`, `pro_forma_work_orders`, `pro_forma_billable_hours`, `pro_forma_revenue_proxy`, `service_van_capex`, `ramp_factor`. Use dollar values to two decimals, ratios and percentages as decimal ratios to at least four decimals (for example, return 0.1863 for 18.63%), and dates as YYYY-MM-DD.
